title: Fediverse capability infiltration: signed posts, content-addressed media, encrypted DMs, capability delegation, content provenance
description:
Sneak modern cryptographic capabilities into ActivityPub via backwards-compatible optional fields. Existing AP servers ignore what they don't understand. Aware servers gain verifiable posts, tamper-evident media, encrypted DMs, delegated authority, and content provenance.

All capabilities build on the DID infrastructure already extracted in fedi-did. Pattern: add optional fields -> extract into crates -> lower adoption barrier -> de facto standard.

Priority order by impact:
1. Signed posts (FEP-8b32 / Linked Data Integrity) — highest value, makes fediverse evidence-based
2. Content-addressed media (SRI hashes) — tamper detection, alternative retrieval
3. Encrypted DMs (DID key exchange) — most requested feature by users
4. Capability delegation (UCANs) — enables cross-server bots and delegation
5. Content provenance (C2PA-lite) — journalism/anti-deepfake use case
